title: Submission of Certified Copies of Documents
text: 2.32 Submission of Certified Copies of Documents Wherever original documents have been submitted to a different RA / nominated agency or to a different division of same RA, applicant can furnish photocopy of documents duly certified by him in lieu of original. WAREHOUSING FACILITY
